title: bidens odorata var. rosea
intro: Bidens odorata var. rosea, commonly known as Rose False Daisy, is a flowering plant species within the Asteraceae family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include treating various health issues such as fever, cough, and digestive problems. The health benefits of Rose False Daisy are attributed to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antispasmodic effects, which help to soothe and calm the body. The plant contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
